summary_md: **Tom Smith ([@TomSmithyzrp](https://x.com/TomSmithyzrp/status/2115735171551121751))** releases **PromptReel**, an MIT, zero-dependency hub that turns one idea into platform-specific prompts and cinematic storyboards for 15 video-generation platforms, usable via web, CLI, MCP or as a skill ([site](https://thanksgiver233.github.io/PromptReel/), [Thanksgiver233/PromptReel](https://github.com/Thanksgiver233/PromptReel)).

referenced_urls.title: GitHub - Thanksgiver233/PromptReel: PromptReel 是一个视频提示词中枢，解决跨平台反复查找、改写模板的问题。同一个创意，可灵要写成五段式，海螺要先给 `[Push in]` 括号运镜，MiniMax H3 要拆成 `[Shot N]` 加音景与配乐，Sora 则要转成英文并声明音频。PromptReel 把这些差异沉淀成 15 套模板：填一次创意、主体、动作与场景，就能得到按所选平台结构重排的整体提示词，以及景别递进、运镜不重复的分镜脚本。除网页外还提供命令行与 MCP 服务，并支持自定义模板。

relevance: Prompt adaptation layer for agentic video generation across platforms.
